description: x402 tools for MCP clients: pay exact/Starknet or STARK-receipt 402s, verify, JCS-hash. No account.
name: tech.vauban/pay-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Starknet Sepolia RPC endpoint for the two chain-reading tools. Optional; defaults to a public node not operated by Vauban.
environmentVariables.name: STARKNET_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Starknet Sepolia account address enabling make_payment chain mode. Optional; without it make_payment returns a hash-only pending result with no network call.
environmentVariables.name: PAY_MCP_SEPOLIA_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: Private key for that account. Optional; never required to try the tools.
environmentVariables.name: PAY_MCP_SEPOLIA_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Standard x402 path: comma-separated payTo addresses pay_for_resource may pay, or * for any. Empty pays nobody (fail closed).
environmentVariables.name: PAY_MCP_STANDARD_X402_PAYEES

environmentVariables.description: Standard x402 path: cap on one payment in atomic units (default 0.1 STRK).
environmentVariables.name: PAY_MCP_STANDARD_X402_MAX_WEI

environmentVariables.description: Standard x402 path: a signer of its own (falls back to PAY_MCP_SEPOLIA_*).
environmentVariables.name: PAY_MCP_STANDARD_X402_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: Private key for that account. Optional.
environmentVariables.name: PAY_MCP_STANDARD_X402_PRIVATE_KEY
